messages:
jen: FYI customer onboards next week with BYOK import to our HSM proxy. Sales wants clear answers on RBAC escalation windows, log custody, and who owns incident notifications. cc @omar @priya

omar: Quick notes: we should offer three entitlement flows: temporary JIT operators (timeboxed, audited), persistent key-operators (limited group, MFA + hardware token), and auditors (read-only, restricted console). JIT should auto-revoke after ttl.

priya: Agree. For audit we need immutable export bundles (signed SHA256 manifests) and a predictable export cadence (daily diffs + weekly full). Export format: compressed JSONL with event metadata and HSM attestation header.

sam: Vulnerability flag: vendor HSM firmware CVE-2024-3456 was disclosed. We need to add a pre-onboard firmware attestation and optional patch window SLA. If customer HSMs are at-risk, we must prevent import until mitigated.

jen: Can we sketch the JIT flow for legal? A short example policy + ticket flow would help. Also what triggers an immediate operator revoke?

omar: Policy sketch (pseudo):
```
Allow if principal in role key-operator AND context.requester_mfa = true AND context.ticket_status = APPROVED AND context.jit_expires > now
```
Trigger reasons for revoke: suspicious import patterns, detection of compromised operator machine, or vendor firmware CVE matching their HSM model.

priya: On detection/action: 1) revoke entitlements, 2) snapshot logs + signed export, 3) instruct vendor to quarantine key material if supported, 4) generate compliance notification template (SOC2/ISO) and deliver to customer. Also rotate any KEK we manage.

jen: For storage/retention costs, customer asked for 3 years immutability. Can we do Object Lock + cold storage lifecycle?

sam: Yes: Object Lock Governance -> transition to Glacier Deep Archive after 90 days. Need to encrypt export with a separate CMK (not the customer's key) and store a signed manifest in a separate signing service. Estimate cost ~ $X/year per TB (I'll attach numbers in ticket).

audit-bot: alert: vendor-firmware-cve-2024-3456 detected for provider "AcmeHSM". Affected models: ACM-2, ACM-3. See internal advisory: https://infra/acmehsm/advisories/3456

omar: For onboarding doc: add a checkbox "Firmware attestation provided" and require HSM serial + firmware hash. If escrowless, we add a clause about no recovery guarantee and recommend key backup instructions.

priya: Also add monitoring rules: CloudTrail events [ImportKeyMaterial, DisableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion], HSM syslog events matching "unseal" or "import". All should create a P1 if multiple distinct operators perform imports within 1h.

jen: Good. Action items: Omar -> draft JIT RBAC + ticket workflow, Priya -> signed export spec + alert rules, Sam -> firmware CVE mitigation pattern + cost estimate. I'll file onboarding ticket and attach this thread. Anyone object to sharing this with Legal?

omar: Share away.

priya: Fine by me.

sam: Go for it.

jen: thanks :white_check_mark:
